game.name: Bee Movie Game (Europe)
game.desc: Bee Movie on Xbox 360 is an action game based on the feature film of the same name. You play as a bee who doesn't want to end up working in the same company and who will try different jobs to find what suits him best. These jobs are all mini-games that you can play in addition to the levels you have to go through. Use your height-related abilities to get out of dangerous situations and find the job of your dreams.
